program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 12.0, 25.0),      # front CS device gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Iext":  (7e-6, 2e-6, 12e-6),     # extra M1 current injected at cascode source node
    "gmid2": (14.0, 8.0, 22.0),       # cascode gm/Id
    "vd1":   (0.25, 0.15, 0.45),      # M1 drain voltage target
    "gmid3": (16.0, 8.0, 22.0),       # follower gm/Id
    "Ifol":  (11e-6, 6e-6, 14e-6),    # follower current (resistor sink)
    "Rf":    (410e3, 400e3, 480e3),   # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (8e-15, 1e-15, 30e-15)   # feedback cap (damping)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Iext, Ifol, Rf, Cf, vd1 = p["Iext"], p["Ifol"], p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["vd1"]
    I1 = iref + Iext
    Idiv = 0.5e-6
    L3 = 0.15

    # ---- DC: vin = vout = Vgs1; x = vout + Vgs3; cascode source at vd1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vd1)
    vout = m1.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], L3, Ifol, vds=VDD - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + m3.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], 0.15, iref, vds=max(vx - vd1, 0.1), vsb=vd1)
    vcas = vd1 + m2.vgs
    RL = max(vout, 0.05) / Ifol
    Rext = (VDD - vd1) / Iext
    Rtot = VDD / Idiv
    Rd2 = vcas / Idiv
    Rd1 = Rtot - Rd2

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "ibias", "vcas", "d1", "vss", m2)    # cascode; IREF loads node x=ibias
    n.R("REXT", "vdd", "d1", Rext)                   # extra M1 current, bypasses x
    n.R("RD1", "vdd", "vcas", Rd1)
    n.R("RD2", "vcas", "vss", Rd2)
    n.C("CCAS", "vcas", "vss", 2e-13)
    n.dev("M3", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", m3)  # follower
    n.R("RL", "vout", "vss", RL)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # ---- small-signal nodal model (nodes: in, d, x, out)
    gm1, gds1, cgd1 = m1.gm, m1.gds, m1.cgd
    cgs1 = max(m1.cgg - cgd1, 0.0)
    gm2, gmb2, gds2 = m2.gm, m2.gmbs, m2.gds
    gm3, gmb3, gds3 = m3.gm, m3.gmbs, m3.gds
    cgd3 = m3.cgd; cgs3 = max(m3.cgg - cgd3, 0.0)
    Cin = cpd + cgs1
    Cd = m1.cdd + m2.cgg + 0.3 * m2.cdd
    Cx = m2.cdd + cgd3
    Cout = cl + 0.3 * m3.cdd
    go = gds3 + 1.0 / RL
    gd = gds1 + gm2 + gmb2 + gds2 + 1.0 / Rext

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        Y = np.array([
            [s * (Cin + cgd1) + yf, -s * cgd1, 0.0, -yf],
            [gm1 - s * cgd1, gd + s * (Cd + cgd1), -gds2, 0.0],
            [0.0, -(gm2 + gmb2 + gds2), gds2 + s * (Cx + cgs3), -s * cgs3],
            [-yf, 0.0, -gm3 - s * cgs3, gm3 + gmb3 + go + s * (Cout + cgs3) + yf]
        ], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        return abs(v[3])

    z0 = zt(1e3)
    f3db = 1e10
    for f in np.logspace(4, 10, 1200):
        if zt(f) < z0 / math.sqrt(2.0):
            f3db = f
            break

    # ---- noise at 1 MHz referred to iin as a current
    k4T = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = k4T * 0.8 / gm1 + (k4T / Rext) / gm1**2
    yin2 = (w * (Cin + cgd1 + Cf))**2 + (1.0 / Rf)**2
    in2 = k4T / Rf + en2 * yin2
    in_noise = 1.1 * math.sqrt(in2)

    power = VDD * (iref + Iext + Ifol + Idiv)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(z0), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": in_noise}

events.topology: Shunt-feedback TIA: NMOS CS (IREF as active load) + in-loop NMOS source follower, Rf from vout to input
